description: For a supplied sequence of finite histories with one-term extensions, there is a unique infinite function whose prefixes of lengths equal to the starting length plus n are exactly the supplied histories.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.history_path_extraction.{u} {α : Type u} (p : ℕ → List α)
  (hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension (p n) (p (n + 1))) :
  ∃! f, ∀ (n : ℕ), (List.ofFn fun i => f ↑i) = p n
